Tripley.Rpc.Tools.TypeScriptGen

Usage:
  tripley-rpc-tsgen manifest export --assembly <contracts.dll> --output <rpc-manifest.json>
  tripley-rpc-tsgen manifest export --project <contracts.csproj> --output <rpc-manifest.json> [--configuration Debug] [--framework net10.0]
  tripley-rpc-tsgen doctor [--project <contracts.csproj>] [--configuration Debug] [--framework net10.0] [--build]
  tripley-rpc-tsgen --manifest <rpc-manifest.json> --output <generated-dir> [--module esm] [--runtime-package-mode inline|import] [--contracts-import-path <path>] [--runtime-import-path <path>] [--notification-payload-map-suffix <text>] [--notification-route-function-suffix <text>] [--header-comment <text>] [--client-name-suffix <text>] [--newline lf|crlf]
  tripley-rpc-tsgen inspect routes --manifest <rpc-manifest.json> [--service <name>] [--method <name>] [--format tree|table]
  tripley-rpc-tsgen inspect manifest --manifest <rpc-manifest.json> [--format tree|table|json]

Options:
  --assembly <path>   Contracts assembly path for manifest export.
  --project <path>    Contracts project path for manifest export.
  --manifest <path>   Input manifest JSON file.
  --output <path>     Output TypeScript directory path.
  --configuration <c> Build configuration for project export. Default: Debug.
  --framework <tfm>   Target framework to build or inspect for the project being exported.
  --build             Build the contracts project before validating target path and manifest export.
  --header-comment <text> Header comment to emit into each generated TypeScript file.
  --client-name-suffix <text> Suffix for generated service client class names. Default: Client.
  --contracts-import-path <path> Import path used by client.ts and notifications.ts for generated DTO types.
  --runtime-import-path <path> Import path used by client.ts when '--runtime-package-mode import' is selected.
  --notification-payload-map-suffix <text> Suffix for generated notification payload map interfaces.
  --notification-route-function-suffix <text> Suffix for generated notification route resolver functions.
  --newline <kind>    Generated file newline mode: 'lf' or 'crlf'. Default: lf.
  --module <kind>     Module target. Only 'esm' is supported.
  --runtime-package-mode <mode> Runtime helper mode: 'inline' or 'import'.
  --service <name>    Filter inspect routes output by service name.
  --method <name>     Filter inspect routes output by method or notification name.
  --format <kind>     Inspect output format: routes support 'tree' or 'table'; manifest supports 'tree', 'table', or 'json'.
  --help, -h          Show usage.
